Description: A threshold that indicates the power consumption of the load has entered an overload condition. It is represented in Amps. Minimum value must be greater than or equal to the value returned by the rPDUOutletConfigMonitoredNearOverloadThreshold OID.  Maximum value must be less than or equal to the value returned by the rPDULoadDevMaxOutletLoad OID.  0 will be returned if the unit is not Outlet Monitored Rack PDU.

Name: raru ident aru index
Description: The index to the ARU entry.

Name: raruident name
Description: A character string identifying the device.

Name: raru config aru index
Description: The index to the ARU entry.

Name: raru config aru name
Description: The name of the ARU.

Name: raru config aru remote setpoint
Description: This OID defines the desired base airflow of the ARU, and sets the speed of the ARU fans when the temperature override is inactive.  Values specified in cfm (cubic feet per minute) can be converted to metric values using the conversion factor:  1 cfm = 1.70 m^3/hr (cubic meters per hour).  Values (1) through (9) are for support of legacy (1st generation) ARUs. Writing these values to a 2nd generation ARU will result in the following: A value greater than (9) will be ignored by a 1st generation ARU.  aruOff      (1) - Ignored aru85F-29C  (2) - 1200 cfm aru90F-32C  (3) - 800 cfm aru95F-35C  (4) - 500 cfm aru100F-38C (5) - 400 cfm aru7kW      (6) - 1200 cfm aru5kW      (7) - 800 cfm aru3kW      (8) - 500 cfm aru2kW      (9) - 400 cfm  NOTE: -1 will be returned if the ARU is not communicating.

Name: raru config aru temp ovrd enable disable
Description: This OID is used to enable/disable the remote temperature override setting of the ARU.  If this OID is set to 1, the remote setting for temperature override is disabled. If this OID is set to 2, the remote setting for temperature override is enabled.

Name: raru config aru temp ovrd setpoint
Description: This OID is the Temperature Override setpoint of the ARU.  NOTE: -1 will be returned if the ARU is not communicating.  Values are represented in whole number degrees using the units specified in the rARUStatusSysTempUnits OID (Celsius or Fahrenheit).

Name: raru config aru master control
Description: This is the master on/off control for the ARU.

Name: raru status aru device count
Description: The total number of ARUs accessible from this IP.

Name: rarustatus sys temp units
Description: The temperature scale used to display the temperature in the system, Celsius(1) or Fahrenheit(2). This setting is based on the system preferences configuration in the agent.

Name: raru status aru index
Description: The index to the ARU entry.

Name: raru status aru alarm state
Description: An ASCII string containing the 8 flags representing the current alarm state of the ARU. If the state of the ARU is unknown, this variable is set to 'UNKNOWN'.  The flags are numbered 1 to 8, read from left to right. The flags are defined as follows:  Flag  1: Fan Fail 1 Flag  2: Fan Fail 2 Flag  3: Fan Fail 3 Flag  4: Smoke (if ARU is equipped with smoke detector)  Flag  5: High Temp (Out of Thermal Control) Flag  6: Over Temp (Exhaust Temp. Exceeds Override Setpoint) Flag  7: Fan Fail 4 (Gen 2 ARU only) Flag  8: Reserved

Name: rarustatus aru comm status
Description: The state of communications to the device. commNeverDiscovered(1) indicates there has never been communications with this device. commsEstablished(2) indicates communication is normal and active with this device. commsLost(3) indicates communication had been established, but is no device.

Name: raru status aru temp ovrd status
Description: Specifies whether the ARU is increasing airflow because exhaust air temperature has exceeded the setting specified in the rARUConfigAruTempOvrdSetpoint OID.

Name: raru status aru master control
Description: This is the master on/off control for the ARU.

Name: rarustatus aru total airflow
Description: The total airflow provided by the aru. Specified in cfm (cubic feet per minute). Can be converted to metric values using the conversion factor: 1 cfm = 1.70 m^3/hr (cubic meters per hour).

Name: raru status aru name
Description: The name of the ARU.

Name: raru status aru remote setpoint
Description: This OID defines the desired base airflow of the ARU, or the speed of the ARU fans when the temperature override is inactive.  See also the rARUConfigAruRemoteSetpoint OID.  NOTE: -1 will be returned if the ARU is not communicating.

Name: raru status aru manual setpoint
Description: Manual operating setpoint of the ARU, which is set on the panel of the ARU. If the ARU doesn't have a manual , the OID will always return a value of aruRem (10).  NOTE: -1 will be returned if the ARU is not communicating.  Values are represented in whole number degrees or kW. If the manual setpoint is set to Remote, or if the ARU doesn't have a manual switch, this OID will return aruRem.

Name: raru status aru temp1
Description: ARU temperature probe #1 reading. The summary exhaust temperature on 2nd generation ARUs.  NOTE: -1 will be returned if the ARU is not communicating.  Values are represented in whole number degrees. Units are displayed in the scale shown in the rARUStatusSysTempUnits OID (Celsius or Fahrenheit).

Name: raru status aru temp2
Description: ARU temperature probe #2 reading. The exhaust temperature in the upper plenum on 2nd generation ARUs.  NOTE: -1 will be returned if the ARU is not communicating.  Values are represented in whole number degrees. Units are displayed in the scale shown in the rARUStatusSysTempUnits OID (Celsius or Fahrenheit).

Name: raru status aru temp3
Description: ARU temperature probe #3 reading. The exhaust temperature in the lower plenum on 2nd generation ARUs.  NOTE: -1 will be returned if the ARU is not communicating.  Values are represented in whole number degrees. Units are displayed in the scale shown in the rARUStatusSysTempUnits OID (Celsius or Fahrenheit).

Name: raru status aru temp ovrd enable disable
Description: This OID indicates whether the ARU remote temperature override is enabled or disabled. If this OID is a 1, the remote setting for temperature override is disabled. If this OID is a 2, the remote setting for temperature override is enabled.

Name: raru status aru temp ovrd setpoint
Description: ARU remote temperature override setpoint setting.  NOTE: -1 will be returned if the ARU is not communicating.  Values are represented in whole number degrees. Units are displayed in the scale shown in the rARUStatusSysTempUnits OID (Celsius or Fahrenheit).

Name: raru fan status aru index: #[1.3.6.1.4.1.318.1.1.14.4.1.1.5]

Name: rarufan status fan runhour counter: #[1.3.6.1.4.1.318.1.1.14.4.1.1.5]

Description: Writing yes to this This OID will reset a fan's total run hour counter, which is shown in the rARUFanStatusFanRunhourCounter OID.

Name: rarufan status nominal fan speed: #[1.3.6.1.4.1.318.1.1.14.4.1.1.5]
Description: The nominal rotational speed (RPM) of the fans when they are operating at the 100% level.

Name: raru fan status selected fan level: #[1.3.6.1.4.1.318.1.1.14.4.1.1.5]
Description: The currently selected ARU speed level, specified in percent of full capacity.

Name: rarufan status replacement threshold: #[1.3.6.1.4.1.318.1.1.14.4.1.1.5]
Description: Threshold above which a run hour alarm will exist, indicating that it might be time to proactively replace a fan.

Name: rarufan status fan operating status: #[1.3.6.1.4.1.318.1.1.14.4.1.1.5]

Name: rarufan status fan rpm speed: #[1.3.6.1.4.1.318.1.1.14.4.1.1.5]
Description: The current rotational speed of the fan, specified in rotations per minute (RPM).

Name: rarufan status fan flow rate: #[1.3.6.1.4.1.318.1.1.14.4.1.1.5]
Description: The flow rate provided by the fan, based on its measured rotational speed. Specified in cfm (cubic feet per minute). Can be converted to metric values using the conversion factor: 1 cfm = 1.70 m^3/hr (cubic meters per hour).

Name: rarufan status fan in service date: #[1.3.6.1.4.1.318.1.1.14.4.1.1.5]

Name: rarusensors temp long inc rate thresh value: #[1.3.6.1.4.1.318.1.1.14.6.4.1.2]
Description: The value of the temperature long-term increasing rate time that will cause an alarm to be generated. The temperature scale is based on the system preferences configuration.

Name: rarusensors location: #[1.3.6.1.4.1.318.1.1.14.6.4.1.2]

Name: rarusensors temp max thresh: #[1.3.6.1.4.1.318.1.1.14.6.4.1.2]

Name: xpdu ident product name
Description: The name of the PDU.

Name: xpdu ident hardware rev
Description: The hardware revision of the PDU. This value is set at the factory.

Name: xpdu ident firmware app rev
Description: An ID string identifying the application firmware revision of the  PDU.

Name: xpdu ident firmware apposrev
Description: An ID string identifying the application operating system firmware revision of the PDU.

Name: xpdu ident firmware controller rev
Description: An ID string identifying the PDU controller firmware revision.

Name: xpdu ident date of manufacture
Description: The date when the PDU was manufactured in mm/dd/yyyy format. This value is set at the factory.

Name: xpdu ident model number
Description: A character string identifying the model number of the PDU. This value is set at the factory.

Name: xpdu ident serial number
Description: A character string identifying the serial number of the PDU. This value is set at the factory.

Name: xpdu device nominal main input voltage
Description: The nominal main input voltage to the PDU. Measured in Volts, line-to-line for a 3-wire (delta) service or line-to-neutral for a 4-wire (wye) service.

Name: xpdu device fans present
Description: Indicates whether or not cooling fans are installed in the PDU.

Name: xpdu device bypass input present
Description: Indicates whether or not the PDU is equipped with a second feed for the UPS device's bypass input.

Name: xpdu device cross tie output present
Description: Indicates whether or not the PDU is equipped with a cross-tie output.

Name: xpdu device earth ground monitor present
Description: Indicates whether or not the PDU can provide ground current measurements.

Name: xpdu device infra stru xure type
Description: Indicates the configuration of this PDU system. Type-B PDU is in a distributed UPS system and has bypass capabilities. Type-C PDU receives power from a larger central UPS.

Name: xpdu device service type
Description: The type of utility input to the PDU. Either 3 wires (delta), or 4 wires (wye).

Name: xpdudevice nominal output voltage
Description: The nominal line-to-neutral output voltage to the load measured in Volts.

Name: xpdudevice main input breaker rating
Description: The rating of the main input breaker measured in Amps.

Name: xpdudevice panel breaker rating
Description: The rating of the panel breaker measured in Amps.

Name: xpdu device transformer present
Description: Indicates whether or not a transformer is installed in the PDU.

Name: xpdu device load tie breaker present
Description: Indicates whether or not a load tie breaker is installed in the PDU.

Name: xpdu device load test port present
Description: Indicates whether or not a load test port is installed in the PDU.

Name: xpdu device fuses present
Description: Indicates whether or not the UPS feed from the PDU includes fuses.

Name: xpdumain input over volt threshold
Description: Threshold above which an input over voltage condition will be generated. Specified as percent deviation from nominal.

Name: xpdumain input under volt threshold
Description: Threshold below which an input under voltage condition will be generated. Specified as percent deviation from nominal. A value of zero indicates that the threshold is disabled.

Name: xpdumain input voltage table size
Description: The number of Main input voltage entries.

Name: xpdumain input voltage phase index
Description: Description of each input phase entry in the table.

Name: xpdu main input voltage ltol
Description: Line-to-line PDU input voltage when an isolation transformer is present, or -1 if no transformer present in this PDU. Measured in tenths of Volts.

Name: xpdu main input voltage lton
Description: Line-to-neutral PDU input voltage when an isolation transformer is not present, or -1 if a transformer is present in this PDU. Measured in tenths of Volts.

Name: xpdubypass input over volt threshold
Description: Threshold above which a bypass input over voltage condition will be generated. Specified as percent deviation from nominal.

Name: xpdubypass input under volt threshold
Description: Threshold below which an bypass input under voltage condition will be generated. Specified as percent deviation from nominal. A value of zero indicates that the threshold is disabled.

Name: xpdubypass input voltage phase table size
Description: The number of bypass input voltage entries.

Name: xpdubypass input voltage phase index
Description: Index of each bypass input phase entry in the table.

Name: xpdu bypass input voltage ltol
Description: Line-to-line bypass input voltage, or -1 if no bypass feed is present in this PDU. Measured in tenths of Volts.

Name: xpdu bypass input voltage lton
Description: Line-to-neutral bypass input voltage, or -1 if no bypass feed is present in this PDU. Measured in tenths of Volts.

Name: xpdu ups input voltage phase table size
Description: The number of UPS input voltage entries.

Name: xpdu ups input voltage phase index
Description: Description of each UPS input phase entry in the table.

Name: xpdu ups input voltage ltonpresent
Description: Indicates whether or not voltage is present at the UPS feed.

Name: xpdusystem output frequency
Description: The system output frequency in tenths of Hertz.

Name: xpdusystem output over current threshold
Description: Threshold above which an over current condition will be generated. Specified as a percent of the panel breaker rating. A value of zero indicates that the threshold is disabled.

Name: xpdusystem output over current neutral threshold
Description: Threshold above which an Over current neutral condition will be generated. Specified as a percent of the panel breaker rating. A value of zero indicates that the threshold is disabled.

Name: xpdusystem output under current threshold
Description: Threshold below which an under current condition will be generated. Specified as a percent of the panel breaker rating. A value of zero indicates that the threshold is disabled.

Name: xpdusystem output table size
Description: The number of System Output phase entries.

Name: xpdusystem output phase index
Description: Description of each output phase entry in the table.

Name: xpdusystem output voltage ltol
Description: Line-to-line system output voltage available at the circuit panel. Measured in tenths of Volts.

Name: xpdusystem output voltage lton
Description: Line-to-neutral system output voltage available at the circuit panel. Measured in tenths of Volts.

Name: xpdusystem output phase current
Description: System load current per phase. Measured in tenths of Amps.

Name: xpdusystem output power
Description: System output power per phase. Measured in tenths of kW.

Name: xpdusystem output apparent power
Description: System output power per phase. Measured in tenths of kVA.

Name: xpdusystem output power factor
Description: Indicates the Power Factor of the system output per phase. A value of 100 representing a unity Power Factor (1.00). Measured in hundredths.

Name: xpdusystem output neutral current
Description: Shows the neutral current measured at the system output in tenths of Amps.

Name: xpdusystem output total power
Description: Shows the total system output power in tenths of kW.

Name: xpdusystem output total apparent power
Description: Shows the total system output power in tenths of kVA.

Name: xpdusystem output total power factor
Description: Indicates the total power factor of the system output. A value of 100 representing a unity power factor (1.00). Measured in hundredths.

Name: xpdusystem output frequency tolerance
Description: Shows the circuit panel output frequency tolerance in Hertz.

Name: xpdusystem output maxkwpower
Description: Defines 100% load in kW. Purpose is to set to match UPS capabilities.

Name: xpdusystem output over volt threshold
Description: Threshold above which an output over voltage condition will be generated. Specified as percent deviation from nominal.

Name: xpdusystem output under volt threshold
Description: Threshold below which an output under voltage condition will be generated. Specified as percent deviation from nominal. A value of zero indicates that the threshold is disabled.

Name: xpduground current
Description: Shows the current measured in the earth ground conductor. Measured in tenths of Amps, or -1 if not available.

Name: xpduground current threshold
Description: Threshold above which a ground current over current condition will be generated. Specified in tenths of Amps.

Name: xpdusystem breaker table size
Description: The number of system breaker entries.

Name: xpdusystem breaker table index
Description: Index of system breaker entries in the table.

Name: xpdusystem breaker description
Description: A brief description of the system breakers.

Name: xpdusystem breaker position
Description: Indicates whether this breaker is open(1) or closed(2).

Name: xpdunum of branch breakers
Description: The number of branch breakers (panel positions) in the Panel. returns 42 for a 1-panel or 84 for a 2-panel system.

Name: xpdubranch breaker table size
Description: The number of branch breaker entries determined by the xPDUNumOfBranchBreakers OID.

Name: xpdubranch breaker table index
Description: Index of branch breaker entries in the table.

Name: xpdubranch breaker name
Description: The description of the purpose/use of the breaker.

Name: xpdubranch breaker location
Description: The description of the location of the breaker.

Name: xpdubranch breaker rating
Description: Indicates current rating of this breaker. 0=Breaker is not present. 1=Earth leakage connection. 2=Neutral connection. A value greater than 2 indicates breaker current rating in Amps. A value above 60 Amp will signify a remote feed. The xPDUBranchBreakerRDPFeed OID will indicate which breakers are configured as a remote drop. Note: When setting branch circuit thresholds/ratings for an entry, all positions tied (see the xPDUBranchBreakerTieIndicator OID) to this entry will inherit the new threshold/rating.

Name: xpdubranch breakerrdpfeed
Description: Indicates that a breaker position is feeding a remote distribution panel.

Name: xpdubranch breaker tie indicator
Description: Indicates whether or not the breaker in this position is logically associated with the breaker immediately below it. This setting is used grouping the breakers feeding a multi-pole branch circuit. Note: When setting an entry's branch breaker tie indicator to breakerTied, all the positions that are tied to this breaker will take on the rating and thresholds for this entry of the table.

Name: xpdubranch breaker current
Description: Indicates the branch current in tenths of  Amps or -1 when not available.

Name: xpdubranch breaker over current threshold
Description: Threshold above which a branch circuit high current condition will be generated. Specified as a percent of the branch breaker rating. A value of zero indicates that the threshold is disabled. Note: When setting branch circuit thresholds/ratings for an entry, all positions tied (see the xPDUBranchBreakerTieIndicator OID) to this entry will inherit the new threshold/rating.

Name: xpdubranch breaker under current threshold
Description: Threshold below which a branch circuit low current condition will be generated. Specified as a percent of the branch breaker rating. A value of zero indicates that the threshold is disabled. Note: When setting branch circuit thresholds/ratings for an entry, all positions tied (see the xPDUBranchBreakerTieIndicator OID) to this entry will inherit the new threshold/rating.

Name: xpdubranch breaker max current threshold
Description: Threshold above which a branch circuit maximum current condition will be generated. Specified as a percent of the branch breaker rating. A value of zero indicates that the threshold is disabled. Note: When setting branch circuit thresholds/ratings for an entry, all positions tied (see the xPDUBranchBreakerTieIndicator OID) to this entry will inherit the new threshold/rating.

Name: xpdubranch breaker min current threshold
Description: Threshold below which a branch circuit minimum current condition will be generated. Specified as a percent of the branch breaker rating. A value of zero indicates that the threshold is disabled. Note: When setting branch circuit thresholds/ratings for an entry, all positions tied (see the xPDUBranchBreakerTieIndicator OID) to this entry will inherit the new threshold/rating.

Name: xatsswitch status selected source
Description: The source which is currently selected, i.e. supplying power to the load.

Name: xats switch status operational mode
Description: The current operating mode of the transfer switch. When the ATS is in automatic mode, generator starting and ATS transferring is all done automatically as needed based on the state of source 1.  Automatic operation is halted when the ATS is in either of the notInAuto modes. A mode of notInAuto indicates that the automatic operation switch is in the disabled position, as indicated by the xATSSwitchStatusAutomaticOperationSwitch OID. The notInAutoAbnormal condition indicates that an abnormal condition has caused the transfer switch to halt automatic operation. In this case, traps can indicate the exact problem. In the case of notInAutoAbnormal, refer to the operation manual for details on how debug the condition and restore automatic operation.

Name: xatsswitch status automatic operation switch
Description: The position of the automatic operation switch on the front of the transfer switch.

Name: xats switch status engine start signal
Description: The position of the Start/Stop contact which signals the generator engine to start/run. When the ATS is in automatic mode, generator starting/stopping is under ATS control.

Name: xatsswitch settings low voltage transfer point
Description: The lowest acceptable voltage condition at source 1. When any phase of source 1 is lower than this voltage, source quality is considered bad and the generator run signal is asserted to begin generator operation. Specified in volts,  line-to-line for a 3-wire service or line-to-neutral for a 4-wire service. -1 if not available.

Name: xatsswitch settings set to factory defaults
Description: Sets all transfer switch settings to factory default values.

Name: xatsswitch settings high voltage transfer point
Description: The highest acceptable voltage condition at source 1. When any phase of source 1 is greater than this voltage, source quality is considered bad and the generator run signal is asserted to begin generator operation. Specified in volts,  line-to-line for a 3-wire service or line-to-neutral for a 4-wire service. -1 if not available.

Name: xatsswitch settings max frequency deviation
Description: The maximum acceptable frequency deviation condition from nominal at source 1. When source 1 frequency is outside the specified range, source quality is considered bad and the generator run signal is asserted to begin generator operation. Specified in  tenths of Hertz above or below nominal. A value of zero indicates that frequency is ignored when determining source quality. -1 if not available.

Name: xatsswitch settings min phase balance
Description: The minimum required phase balance at source 1. When the percentage difference between the minimum and maximum phase voltage measurements at source 1 is greater than this value, source quality is considered bad and the generator run signal is asserted to begin generator operation. Specified as a percentage. A value of zero indicates that phase balance is ignored when determining source quality. -1 if not available.

Name: xats switch settings nominal rotation
Description: The nominal phase rotation (or phase sequence) required by the load. For certain types of equipment, such as rotating machinery, phase rotation is critical for proper operation as it determines the direction which motors will rotate (clockwise or counterclockwise). Source quality will be seen as bad if the rotation measured at that ATS input does not match this setting. If this setting is set to any, phase rotation is ignored.

Name: xatsswitch settings allow closed transfer
Description: This setting enables seamless (closed) transfers between sources. When possible, both source 1 and source 2 are closed to the output for a brief time. If closed transfer is not possible within the amount of time specified by the xATSSwitchSettingsMaxSyncTime OID, an open transfer will be executed.

Name: xatsswitch settings max sync time
Description: When attempting/seeking to perform a closed transfer, this setting defines the maximum time allowed before the transfer switch will give up and perform an open transfer. Specified in seconds. -1 if not available.

Name: xatsswitch settings neutral transfer time
Description: This setting defines how long both source 1 and source 2 will be disconnected from the output, during an open transfer. Specified in seconds. -1 if not available.

Name: xatsswitch settings clear latched alarms
Description: Clears any latched alarm conditions.

Name: xatsswitch timers table size
Description: The number of transfer switch timer entries.

Name: xatsswitch timers index
Description: Index of timer entries in the table.

Name: xats switch timers name
Description: Name of the individual timer.Refer to ATS operation manual, or on-line help, for detailed descriptions of ATS timers.

Name: xatsswitch timers abort
Description: This aborts the individual timer.

Name: xatsswitch timers status
Description: The status of the individual timer. Designates whether this timer entry is currently running or inactive.

Name: xatsswitch timers remaining time
Description: The time remaining for this timer entry. Specified in seconds.

Name: xats switch timers delay setting
Description: The delay settings associated with this timer entry. When this timer entry is active, the timer value must exceed this setting before the ATS behavior associated with this timer is executed. Refer to ATS operation manual, or on-line help, for detailed descriptions of ATS timers.

Name: xats switch block map table size
Description: The number of blocking map entries, or how many ATS actions can be blocked.

Name: xatsswitch block map index
Description: Index of blocking map entries in the table.

Name: xats switch block map name
Description: A string describing the ATS action to be blocked.

Name: xats switch block map status
Description: Represents the status of this blocking map entry, in bit-mapped format. A non-zero value indicates that this entry's ATS action is currently being blocked. The bit(s) set indicate which input(s) are causing the blocking (bit0, bit1, etc).  bit 0 - Contact 1 bit 1 - Contact 2 bit 2 - Contact 3 bit 3 - Contact 4.

Name: xats switch block map setting
Description: This setting designates the inputs that block the ATS action The mapping is specified as a bit-field, where each bit set indicates the input that blocks the ATS action associated with the entry.  bit 0 - Contact 1 bit 1 - Contact 2 bit 2 - Contact 3 bit 3 - Contact 4.

Name: xats switch statistics name

Name: xats switch statistics value

Name: xats switch statistics reset
Description: This will reset the individual ATS statistic associated with this entry.

Name: xatssystem output total power
Description: Shows the total system output power in tenths of kW.

Name: xatssystem output total power factor
Description: Indicates the total power factor of the system output. A value of 100 representing a unity power factor (1.00) Specified in hundredths.

Name: xatssystem output frequency tolerance

Name: xatssystem output over volt threshold
Description: Threshold above which an output over voltage condition will be generated. Specified as tenths of percent deviation from nominal. A value of zero indicates that the threshold is disabled.

Name: xatssystem output under volt threshold
Description: Threshold below which an output under voltage condition will be generated. Specified as tenths of percent deviation from nominal. A value of zero indicates that the threshold is disabled.

Description: Threshold above which an over current condition will be generated. Specified as a percent of the transfer switch rating (xATSDeviceTransferSwitchRating OID). A value of zero indicates that the threshold is disabled.

Name: xatssystem output under current threshold
Description: Threshold below which an under current condition will be generated. Specified as a percent of the transfer switch rating (xATSDeviceTransferSwitchRating OID). A value of zero indicates that the threshold is disabled.

Name: xatstesting status select test process
Description: Type of tests that can be selected when no test has been scheduled. engineStartTest and systemLoadTest may be selected when no tests are running.  Tests that are selected may be canceled manually.

Name: xatstesting status test status
Description: The present system test status/state.

Name: xatstesting status profile warmup time
Description: The amount of time that the generator will warm up during a test. This is portion of the test when the xATSTestingStatusTestStatus OID returns the value engineWarmingUp. Specified in seconds.

Name: xats testing status profile loaded time
Description: The amount of time that ATS will apply the system load to the generator during a system load test. This is portion of the test when the xATSTestingStatusTestStatus OID returns the value testingWithLoad. Specified in minutes.

Name: xatstesting status profile unloaded time
Description: The amount of time that the generator will run following the warm up portion of a start test, or the loaded portion of a load test. This is portion of the test when the xATSTestingStatusTestStatus OID returns the value testingWithoutLoad. Specified in seconds.

Name: xatstesting results last date of test
Description: Date of the last test that was performed, either scheduled or manual. Test results are available in the xATSTestingResultsLastResult OID. Specified in the dd/mm/yyyy format, or 'none' if not available.

Name: xats testing results last result
Description: The result of the last ATS/generator system test.

Name: xatstesting results test last test time
Description: Time of day at which the last test was performed, either scheduled or manual. Test results are available in the xATSTestingResultsLastResult OID. Specified in the hh:mm:ss format, or 'none' if not available.

Name: xatstesting results last crank duration
Description: The time spent cranking the generator before it started during the last test. Specified in seconds, or -1 if not available.

Name: xatstesting results last warmup duration
Description: The time spent in the engineWarmingUp state during the last system test. Specified in seconds, or -1 if not available.

Name: xatstesting results last loaded duration
Description: The time spent in the testingWithLoad state during the last system test. Specified in seconds, or -1 if not available.

Name: xatstesting results last unloaded duration
Description: The time spent in the testingWithoutLoad state during the last system test. Specified in seconds, or -1 if not available.

Name: xatstesting schedule frequency
Description: The frequency of running scheduled tests.

Name: xatstesting schedule test day
Description: The desired day for the scheduled test. This object applies only when the xATSTestingScheduleFrequency OID is set to weekly or monthly. For weekly test frequency, the string is the day the test will be run. For monthly test frequency, the string indicates the day, and the instance within the month. For example, for monthly frequency: 2nd Sunday, 3rd Monday, 4th Tuesday, for weekly frequency: Sunday, Monday, Tuesday.

Name: xatstesting schedule test time
Description: The time of day that the scheduled test will occur. Specified in the format hh:mm.

Name: xatstesting schedule test with load interval
Description: This setting specifies which system tests should include applying the load to the generator. The applyLoadMonthlyDetailed entry in the list will apply load once, for each month represented in the xATSTestingScheduleTestWithLoadSelectMonth OID.

Name: xatstesting schedule test with load select month
Description: The detailed selection for testing with load on a month-by-month basis. This object is applicable when the xATSTestingScheduleTestWithLoadInterval is set to applyLoadMonthlyDetailed. Otherwise this selection will be ignored. Format for this string is a comma-separated entry of months. For example: Jan,Mar,Dec. The string will return 'No Months Scheduled' if no months have been selected.

Name: xatstesting schedule next test date
Description: The date of the next scheduled test, in the format dd-mmm-yyyy.

Name: xatstesting simulate power fail test
Description: This object executes a simulated power failure for the duration indicated. Simulation can be aborted by selecting cancelSimulation.

Name: xatstesting simulate power fail time remaining
Description: Indicates the time remaining in seconds, for a simulated power failure. a value of zero indicates that simulated power failure is not active.

Name: xatsgenerator ident max power rating

Description: The name or label for the generator connected to the source 2 of the ATS.

Name: xatsgenerator status operational
Description: The operational status of the generator. unavailable when unrecognized status is received.

Name: xatsgenerator status mode switch position
Description: The position of the generator's auto-mode switch. In automatic mode, the generator is started and stopped via the remote start contact, which has state indicated in the xATSGeneratorStatusRemoteStart OID. In manual mode generator start/stop control is via local command only. Off prevents the generator from running.

Name: xatsgenerator status remote start
Description: The status of the generator's remote start contact, which is provided as an output from the transfer switch to start/stop the generator when in automatic mode.

Name: xatsgenerator adv status battery voltage

Name: xatsgenerator settings stop delay
Description: The delay, in seconds, before the generator will stop after the remote run signal is deactivated, or -1 if not available.

Name: xatsgenerator settings crank cycle enable
Description: When Crank Cycle is enabled, the engine will be cranked up to the time specified by the xATSGeneratorSettingsCrankTime OID. If the generator's engine does not start, there will be a pause as specified by the xATSGeneratorSettingsCrankRestTime OID before the engine will be cranked again. This cycle is repeated as specified by the xATSGeneratorSettingsNumberCrank OID. When crank cycle is disabled, the generator's engine will be cranked continuously until it starts.

Name: xatsgenerator settings crank time
Description: The duration of engine cranking, in seconds, when starting the generator. Applicable when the xATSGeneratorSettingsCrankCycleEnable OID is enabled. -1 if not available.

Name: xatsgenerator settings crank rest time
Description: The pause duration, in seconds, following an unsuccessful attempt to start the generator. Applicable when the xATSGeneratorSettingsCrankCycleEnable OID is enabled. -1 if not available.

Name: xatsgenerator settings number crank
Description: The number of failed crank attempts before giving up on starting the generator. Applicable when the xATSGeneratorSettingsCrankCycleEnable OID is enabled. -1 if not available.

Description: Specifies the use of metric units in generator related OIDs, as well as on all other interfaces including the generator's local interface.

Name: xatsgenerator service run hours until service date
Description: Run hours until the next generator service is due, in hours. Based on the xATSGeneratorServiceRunHoursThreshold OID or -1 if the run hour-based threshold is set to off.

Name: xatsgenerator service run hours threshold
Description: Run hour-based service interval. When the run-hours since service surpasses this threshold, generator service is due.

Name: xatsgenerator service calendar interval threshold
Description: Calendar-based service interval. When the next service date, as indicated by the xATSGeneratorServiceNextServiceDate OID is in the past, generator is due for service.

Name: xatsgenerator service engine starts lifetime
Description: Number of engine starts over the life of the generator. -1 if not available.

Name: xatsgenerator service totalk wh lifetime
Description: Total kWh of operation over the life of the generator. -1 if not available.

Name: xatsgenerator service total run hours since maintenance

Name: xatsgenerator service engine starts since maintenance

Name: xatsgenerator service totalk wh maintenance

Name: rpdu 2group number of devices
Description: Getting this OID will return the number of Rack PDU devices contributing to the Network Port Sharing (NPS) group power and energy values. Queries to guest units in an NPS group are not applicable and will return 0.

Name: rpdu 2group total power
Description: Getting this OID will return the total power consumption of the Rack PDU Network Port Sharing (NPS) group devices in hundredths of kilowatts. Queries to guest units in an NPS group are not applicable and will return 0.

Name: rpdu 2group total energy
Description: Getting this OID will return the total energy consumption of the Rack PDU Network Port Sharing (NPS) group devices in tenths of kilowatt-hours.  To reset the energy meters for each of the Rack PDU devices that contribute to this value, see the rPDU2GroupEnergyReset OID.  To view the start time for each of the Rack PDU device energy meters that contribute to this value, see the rPDU2DeviceStatusEnergyStartTime OID.  Queries to guest units in an NPS group are not applicable and will return 0.

Name: rpdu 2group energy reset
Description: Setting this OID to reset (2) will cause the device energy meter value on each device in the Rack PDU Network Port Sharing (NPS) group to be reset to zero.  Each device in the Rack PDU group will also have its corresponding rPDU2DeviceStatusEnergyStartTime OID value updated.  Getting this OID in models that support this feature will do nothing and return the noOperation(1) value.  Models that do not support this feature, as well as guest units in an NPS group, will respond to this OID with a value of notSupported (3). Attempts to set this OID in these units will fail.

Name: rpdu 2device control command
Description: Setting this OID to immediateAllOn (1) will turn all outlets on immediately.  Setting this OID to delayedAllOn (2) will turn all outlets on as defined by each outlet's rPDU2OutletSwitchedConfigPowerOnTime OID value.  Setting this OID to immediateAllOff (3) will turn all outlets off immediately.  Setting this OID to immediateAllReboot (4) will cause an immediateAllOff command to be performed. Once all outlets are off, the Switched Rack PDU will then delay the rPDU2OutletSwitchedConfigRebootDuration OID time, and then perform an immediateAllOn command.  Setting this OID to delayedAllReboot (5) will cause a delayedAllOff command to be performed. Once all outlets are off, the Switched Rack PDU will then delay the largest rPDU2OutletSwitchedConfigRebootDuration OID time, and then perform a delayedAllOn command.  Setting this OID to noCommandAll (6) will have no effect.  Setting this OID to delayedAllOff (7) will turn all outlets off as defined by each outlet's rPDU2OutletSwitchedConfigPowerOffTime OID value.  Setting this OID to cancelAllPendingCommands (8) will cause all pending commands on the Switched Rack PDU to be cancelled.  Getting this OID will return the noCommandAll (6) value.

Description: Getting this variable will return the outlet state. If the outlet is on, the immediateOn (1) value will be returned. If the outlet is off, the immediateOff (2) value will be returned. If the state of the outlet cannot be determined, the outletUnknown (4) value will be returned. If the outletUnknown condition should occur, all devices powered by the PDU should be shut down. The PDU's power should then be cycled to clear this condition.  Setting this variable to immediateOn (1) will immediately turn the outlet on.  Setting this variable to immediateOff (2) will immediately turn the outlet off.  Setting this variable to immediateReboot (3) will cause the Switched Rack PDU to perform an immediateOff command, wait the rPDU2OutletSwitchedConfigRebootDuration OID time, and then perform an immediateOn command.  Setting this variable to delayedOn (5) will turn the outlet on after the rPDU2OutletSwitchedConfigPowerOnTime OID time has elapsed.  Setting this variable to delayedOff (6) will turn the outlet off after the rPDU2OutletSwitchedConfigPowerOffTime OID time has elapsed.  Setting this variable to delayedReboot  (7) will cause the Switched Rack PDU to perform a delayedOff command, wait the rPDU2OutletSwitchedConfigRebootDuration OID time, and then perform a delayedOn command.  Setting this variable to cancelPendingCommand (8) will cause any pending command to this outlet to be cancelled.

Name: pmm input frequency deviation
Description: Displays the input frequency deviation in Hertz. Threshold write returns as unsuccessful if one of the breaker threshold groups does not meet conditions. In this case, read the thresholds to know which threshold group's write condition is not met. Threshold needs to be enabled to read value

Name: pmm input power factor deviation
Description: Displays the input power factor deviation. Specified in tenths. A value of zero indicates that the threshold is disabled. Returns -1 if unsupported. Threshold write returns as unsuccessful if one of the breaker threshold groups does not meet conditions. In this case, read the thresholds to know which threshold group's write condition is not met. Threshold needs to be enabled to read value

Name: ats5g num devices

Description: This value is the data entry's index in the identity table.

Name: ats5g identaosrev
Description: This is the operating system firmware revision of the network management card.

Name: ats5g ident app rev
Description: This is the application firmware revision of the network management card.

Name: ats5g ident config name
Description: This is the configurable name of the device. It may be up to 255 characters long.

Name: ats5g ident config location
Description: This is the configurable location of the device. It may be up to 255 characters long.

Name: ats5g ident config contact
Description: This is the configurable contact information of the device. It may be up to 255 characters long.

Name: ats5g ident config module id
Description: This value is ID number that can be configured for each device. It cannot be greater than the maximum number of devices in the network port sharing (NPS) group (32). Changing this value causes the device to reboot, which will likely result in an SNMP timeout error even when the write attempt is successful.

Name: ats5g ident module type
Description: This value describes the role the specified device holds in the device group: notNPS(1) specifies that the device is not in a group host(2) specifies that a device will broadcast firmware updates to guests guest(3) specifies that a device will accept firmware updates from the host

Name: ats5g ident module status
Description: This value tracks the communication status of a device within the group.

Name: ats5g ident serial number
Description: This is the serial number of the automatic transfer switch.

Name: ats5g ident model number
Description: This is the model number of the automatic transfer switch.

Name: ats5g ident hardware rev
Description: This is the hardware revision of the automatic transfer switch.

Name: ats5g ident manufacture date

Name: ats5g ident bootmon rev

Name: ats5g switch device index
Description: This value is the data entry's index in the switching table.

Name: ats5g switch sourceastatus
Description: This is the input status of source A. The ATS will use source B as the selected source while this value is fail(1).

Name: ats5g switch sourcebstatus
Description: This is the input status of source B. The ATS will use source A as the selected source while this value is fail(1).

Name: ats5g switch rated voltage
Description: This is the default nominal line VRMS in volts (V) for this unit.

Name: ats5g switch config nominal voltage
Description: This is the configurable line VRMS in volts (V) that will be used to select sources.

Name: ats5g switch config transfer voltage range
Description: This value specifies which voltage transfer range should be used to disqualify sources and raise alarms. The narrow transfer voltage must be less than the medium transfer voltage, which must be less than the wide transfer voltage. If the difference between ats5gSwitchConfigNominalVoltage and a source's measured VRMS is greater than the value specified by the selected transfer range, the ATS will disqualify that source. The ATS will be in a 'lost redundancy' state until the source recovers or the configuration is updated.

Name: ats5g switch config transfer voltage wide
Description: This is the configurable transfer range in volts (V) used to disqualify sources when ats5gSwitchConfigTransferVoltageRange is wide(1).

Name: ats5g switch config transfer voltage medium
Description: This is the configurable transfer range in volts (V) used to disqualify sources when ats5gSwitchConfigTransferVoltageRange is medium(2).

Name: ats5g switch config transfer voltage narrow
Description: This is the configurable transfer range in volts (V) used to disqualify sources when ats5gSwitchConfigTransferVoltageRange is narrow(3).

Name: ats5g switch config voltage sensitivity
Description: This is the configured sensitivity threshold for rapid changes to input voltage. It is recommended to use high(1) unless frequent small changes are expected.

Name: ats5g switch sourceavoltage
Description: This is the measured line VRMS of source A reported in volts (V).

Name: ats5g switch moduleid
Description: This value is the ats5gIdentConfigModuleID of the device being queried.

Name: ats5g switch sourcebvoltage
Description: This is the measured line VRMS of source B reported in volts (V).

Name: ats5g switch rated frequency
Description: This is the default nominal line frequency for this unit reported in Hertz (Hz).

Name: ats5g switch config nominal frequency
Description: This is the configurable line frequency in Hertz (Hz) that will be used to select sources. If the difference between ats5gSwitchConfigNominalFrequency and a source's measured frequency is greater than ats5gSwitchConfigFrequencyDeviation, the ATS will disqualify that source. The ATS will be in a 'lost redundancy' state until the source recovers or the configuration is updated.

Name: ats5g switch config frequency deviation
Description: This is the configurable frequency deviation in Hertz (Hz) that will be used to select sources.

Name: ats5g switch sourceafrequency
Description: This is the measured line frequency of source A reported in Hertz (Hz).

Name: ats5g switch sourcebfrequency
Description: This is the measured line frequency of source B reported in Hertz (Hz).

Name: ats5g switch event count start time
Description: This value is the time and date of the last event count reset action.

Name: ats5g switch event count redundancy loss
Description: This value tracks the number of redundancy loss events. It increments each time a source becomes invalid.

Name: ats5g switch event count source switch
Description: This value tracks the number of source switch events. It increments each time the selected source changes.

Name: ats5g switch event count source pref change
Description: This value tracks the number of preferred source configuration change events. It increments each time the user updates their source preference.

Name: ats5g switch orientation
Description: This value describes the voltage orientation of the ATS.

Name: ats5g switch event count spike or drop
Description: This value tracks voltage spike and drop events. It increments each time a source's measured instantaneous voltage increases or decreases rapidly. This depends on configured voltage sensitivity.

Name: ats5g switch event count surge or droop
Description: This value tracks voltage surge or droop events. It increments each time a source's calculated VRMS increases or decreases rapidly. This does not depend on any user configurations.

Name: ats5g switch event count freq out of range
Description: This value tracks frequency threshold violations. It increments each time a source is disqualified because the difference between its measured frequency and the configured nominal frequency is greater than the configured frequency deviation.

Name: ats5g switch control event count reset
Description: This control resets the event counts when the value is set to reset(2).

Name: ats5g switch voltage out status
Description: This value is on(2) while the output outlets are powered.

Name: ats5g switch over current state
Description: This value is atsOverCurrent(1) when the ATS has exceeded the output current threshold and will not allow a switch over to the alternate power source if the current source fails.

Name: ats5g switch phase sync status
Description: This value tracks the phase sync status.

Name: ats5g switch sourcea24vsupply status

Name: ats5g switch sourceb24vsupply status
Description: This value tracks the internal source B 24VDC power supply status.

Name: ats5g switch sourcea48vsupply status
Description: This value tracks the internal source A 48VDC power supply status.

Name: ats5g switch cumulative alarm status
Description: This is the severity of the most severe alarm currently active.

Name: ats5g switch sourceb48vsupply status
Description: This value tracks the internal source B 48VDC power supply status.

Name: ats5g switch3p3vsupply status
Description: This value tracks the internal 3.3VDC power supply status.

Name: ats5g switch communication status
Description: This is the communication status between the network management card and the automatic transfer switch.

Name: ats5g switch config front panel lockout
Description: This is the configurable lockout status of the source preference toggle button on the front panel. The button does nothing while the front panel is locked.

Name: ats5g switch config preferred source
Description: This is the configurable source preference. If the ATS is fully redundant the preferred source will be the selected source. If the preferred source is none(3), the ATS will switch sources only in response to measured changes in each source.

Name: ats5g switch selected source
Description: This is the selected source that will be used to power downstream devices.

Name: ats5g switch redundancy state
Description: This is the ATS redundancy status. While this value is atsFullyRedundant(2), either input may be used to power downstream devices. While this value is atsRedundancyLost(1), one input has failed validation and downstream devices may lose power if the selected source is lost.

Name: ats5g env device index

Name: ats5g env config hum low threshold

Name: ats5g env config hum min threshold

Name: ats5g env config hum hysteresis

Name: ats5g env config hum alarms enabled

Name: ats5g env peak temperature

Name: ats5g env peak temp reset time

Name: ats5g env control peak temp reset
Description: This control resets the peak temperature when the value is set to reset(2).

Name: ats5g env moduleid
Description: This value is the ats5gIdentConfigModuleID of the device being queried.

Name: ats5g env sensor type
Description: This value is the type of the currently attached sensor accessory.

Name: ats5g env alarm status
Description: This is the severity of the most severe environment-specific alarm currently active.

Name: ats5g env temperature
Description: This is the measured temperature of the attached sensor reported in tenth-degrees Fahrenheit. The value reports as -1 if the attached sensor does not support temperature measurements.

Name: ats5g env config temp max threshold
Description: This is the configured maximum temperature threshold reported in degrees Fahrenheit. The value reports as -1 if the attached sensor does not support temperature measurements.

Name: ats5g env config temp high threshold
Description: This is the configured high temperature threshold reported in degrees Fahrenheit. The value reports as -1 if the attached sensor does not support temperature measurements.

Name: ats5g env config temp hysteresis
Description: This is the configured temperature threshold hysteresis reported in degrees Fahrenheit. The value reports as -1 if the attached sensor does not support temperature measurements.

Name: ats5g env config temp alarms enabled
Description: This is the configured temperature monitoring status. While this value is disabled(1), no temperature-related alarms will be active. The value reports as -1 if the attached sensor does not support temperature measurements.

Name: ats5g bank table size

Description: This value is the data entry's index in the bank table.

Description: This value tracks the load status of the specified bank.

Description: This value is the ats5gIdentConfigModuleID of the device being queried.

Name: ats5g bank type
Description: This value describes the type of bank associated with this bank index. If a device has multiple banks, then its total(1) output will include the bank1(2) and bank2(3) outputs.

Name: ats5g bank output tenth amps
Description: This value is the measured output of the specified bank reported in tenths of amps (A).

Name: spdu ident date of manufacture

Name: spdu ident model number
Description: A 10-character string identifying the model number of the PDU internal. This value is set at the factory.

Name: spdu ident serial number
Description: A 12-character string identifying the serial number of the PDU internal microprocessor. This value is set at the factory.

Name: spdumaster control switch
Description: Setting this OID to turnAllOnNow (1) will turn all outlets on immediately.  Setting this OID to turnAllOnSequence (2) will turn all outlets on as defined by each outlet's sPDUOutletPowerOnTime OID value.  Setting this OID to turnAllOff (3) will turn all outlets off immediately.  Setting this OID to rebootAllNow (4) will reboot all outlets immediately.  For MasterSwitch firmware version 1.X, setting this OID to rebootAllSequence (5) reboots all outlets, with power returned to the outlets in the sequence defined by each outlet's sPDUOutletPowerOnTime OID value.  For MasterSwitch firmware version 2.X, setting this OID to rebootAllSequence (5) will cause a turnAllOffSequence to be performed. Once all outlets are off, the MasterSwitch will then delay the sPDUMasterConfigReboot OID time, and then perform a turnAllOnSequence.  For MasterSwitch firmware version 2.X, setting this OID to turnAllOffSequence (7) will turn all outlets off as defined by each outlet's sPDUOutletPowerOffTime OID value.  For MasterSwitch firmware version 1.X, setting this OID to turnAllOffSequence (7) will have no effect.  Getting this OID will return the noCommand (6) value.

Name: spdu master state
Description: Getting this OID will cause the status of all outlets to be returned. This OID is provided for informational purposes only. To change the outlet state, the user should use the sPDUOutletCtl OID in the sPDUOutletControlTable.  The format of the data returned is a character string consisting of the word 'On' if the outlet is on or 'Off' if the outlet is off. At least one space will delimit each outlet entry in the string.  If the outlet states are unknown, the character string 'Unknown' will be returned. This signifies that there is an inconsistency in the PDU. In the rare case that this should happen, the user is advised to shut down all equipment powered by the PDU and then cycle the PDU's power. This will put the PDU in a consistent state.

Name: spdu master pending
Description: Getting this OID will cause the command pending status of all outlets to be returned.  The format of the data returned is a character string consisting of the word 'Yes' if a command is pending for the outlet or 'No' if there is no command pending for the outlet. At least one space will delimit each outlet entry in the string.  If the pending states are unknown, the character string 'Unknown' will be returned. This signifies that there is an inconsistency in the PDU. In the rare case that this should happen, the user is advised to shut down all equipment powered by the PDU and then cycle the PDU's power. This will put the PDU in a consistent state.

Name: spdu master config power on
Description: The amount of delay, in seconds, between when power is provided to the PDU and when the PDU provides basic master power to the outlets.  Allowed values are:  -1 never apply power automatically. 0 apply power immediately. 15 apply power in 15 seconds. 30 apply power in 30 seconds. 45 apply power in 45 seconds. 60 apply power in 60 seconds  (1 minute). 120 apply power in 120 seconds (2 minutes). 300 apply power in 300 seconds (5 minutes).  If a value other than a supported value is provided in a set request, the PDU interprets it as the next lower acceptable value.  If the provided value is lower than the lowest acceptable value, the lowest acceptable value is used.

Name: spdu master config reboot
Description: During a reboot sequence, power is turned off and then back on. This OID defines the amount of time to wait, in seconds, after turning the power off, at the start of the sequence, before turning power back on, at the end of the reboot sequence.  Allowed values are:  5 wait 5 seconds between off/on. 10 wait 10 seconds between off/on. 15 wait 15 seconds between off/on. 20 wait 20 seconds between off/on. 30 wait 30 seconds between off/on. 45 wait 45 seconds between off/on. 60 wait 60 seconds (1 minute) between off/on.  If a value other than a supported value is provided in a set request, the PDU interprets it as the next lower acceptable value.  If the provided value is lower than the lowest acceptable value, the lowest acceptable value is used.  This OID is read-only for the MasterSwitch version 2.X and is the maximum sPDUOutletRebootDuration OID of the individual outlets.

Name: spdu master config pdu name
Description: The name of the PDU.

Name: spdu outlet control table size
Description: The number of outlets for the PDU.

Name: spduoutlet control index
Description: The index to the outlet entry.

Name: spdu outlet pending
Description: Reports whether the current outlet has a pending command.  If the commandPendingUnknown (3) value is returned, all devices powered by the PDU should be shut down. The PDU's power should then be cycled to clear this condition.

Name: spdu outlet ctl
Description: Getting this variable will return the outlet state. If the outlet is on, the outletOn (1) value will be returned. If the outlet is off, the outletOff (2) value will be returned.  If the state of the outlet cannot be determined, the outletUnknown (4) value will be returned. If the outletUnknown condition should occur, all devices powered by the PDU should be shut down. The PDU's power should then be cycled to clear this condition.  Setting this variable to outletOn (1) will turn the outlet on.  Setting this variable to outletOff (2) will turn the outlet off.  Setting this variable to outletReboot (3) will reboot the outlet.  Setting this variable to outletOnWithDelay (5) will turn the outlet on after the sPDUOutletPowerOnTime OID has elapsed. This option is not valid for MasterSwitch firmware version 1.X.  Setting this variable to outletOffWithDelay (6) will turn the outlet off after the sPDUOutletPowerOffTime OID has elapsed. This option is not valid for MasterSwitch firmware version 1.X.  Setting this variable to outletRebootWithDelay (7) will turn the outlet off after the sPDUOutletPowerOffTime OID has elapsed, wait the sPDUOutletRebootDuration OID time, then turn the outlet back on. This option is not valid for MasterSwitch firmware version 1.X.

Name: spduoutlet ctl name
Description: The name of the outlet. Maximum size is 20 characters. This OID is provided for informational purposes only. This value is set by the sPDUOutletName OID.

Name: spdu outlet config table size
Description: The number of outlets for the PDU.

Name: spduoutlet config index
Description: The index to the outlet entry.

Name: spdu outlet power on time
Description: The amount of time (in seconds) the outlet will delay powering on when the MasterSwitch is powered on.  Allowed values are:  -1 never power on automatically. 0  power on with the Master Switch. 15 power on 15 seconds after the MasterSwitch has power applied. 30 power on 30 seconds after the MasterSwitch has power applied. 45 power on 45 seconds after the MasterSwitch has power applied. 60 power on 60 seconds (1 minute) after the MasterSwitch has power applied. 120 power on 120 seconds (2 minutes) after the MasterSwitch has power applied. 300 power on 300 seconds (5 minutes) after the MasterSwitch has power applied.  If a value other than a supported value is provided in a set request, the PDU interprets it as the next lower acceptable value.  If the provided value is lower than the lowest acceptable value, the lowest acceptable value is used.

Name: spduoutlet name
Description: The name of the outlet. Maximum size is 20 characters.

Name: spdu outlet power off time
Description: The amount of time (in seconds) the outlet will delay powering off.  Allowed values are:  -1 never power off automatically. 0  power off with the MasterSwitch. 15 power off 15 seconds after being commanded. 30 power off 30 seconds after being commanded. 45 power off 45 seconds after being commanded. 60 power off 60 seconds (1 minute) after being commanded. 120 power off 120 seconds (2 minutes) after being commanded. 300 power off 300 seconds (5 minutes) after being commanded.  If a value other than a supported value is provided in a set request, the PDU interprets it as the next lower acceptable value.  If the provided value is lower than the lowest acceptable value, the lowest acceptable value is used.  This OID is not available for MasterSwitch firmware version 1.X.

Name: spdu outlet reboot duration
Description: During a reboot sequence, power is turned off and then back on. This OID defines the amount of time to wait, in seconds, after turning the power off, at the start of the sequence, before turning power back on, at the end of the reboot sequence.  Allowed values are:  5 wait 5 seconds between off/on. 10 wait 10 seconds between off/on. 15 wait 15 seconds between off/on. 20 wait 20 seconds between off/on. 30 wait 30 seconds between off/on. 45 wait 45 seconds between off/on. 60 wait 60 seconds (1 minute) between off/on.  If a value other than a supported value is provided in a set request, the PDU interprets it as the next lower acceptable value.  If the provided value is lower than the lowest acceptable value, the lowest acceptable value is used.  This OID is not available for MasterSwitch firmware version 1.X.

Name: spduident firmware rev vm

Name: spduident date of manufacture vm

Name: spduident model number vm
Description: A 17-character string identifying the model number of the MasterSwitch VM. This value is set at the factory.

Name: spduident serial number vm
Description: A 17-character string identifying the serial number of the MasterSwitch VM. This value is set at the factory.

Name: spdumaster control vm table size
Description: The number of MasterSwitch VMs controllable by this IP address.

Name: spdumaster control vm index
Description: The index to the MasterSwitch VM entry.

Name: spdumaster control vm name
Description: The name of the MasterSwitch VM. The maximum value is 23 characters. The name is set by using the sPDUMasterConfigVMName OID.

Name: spdumaster control vm command
Description: Setting this OID to immediateAllOnVM (2) will turn all outlets on immediately.  Setting this OID to immediateAllOffVM (3) will turn all outlets off immediately.  Setting this OID to immediateAllRebootVM (4) will reboot all outlets immediately.  Setting this OID to delayedAllOnVM (5) will turn all outlets on as defined by each outlet's sPDUOutletConfigVMPowerOnTime OID value.  Setting this OID to delayedAllOffVM (6) will turn all outlets off as defined by each outlet's sPDUOutletConfigVMPowerOffTime OID value.  Setting this OID to sequencedAllRebootVM (7) will cause a immediateAllOffVM command to be performed. The MasterSwitch VM will then delay the sPDUMasterStatusVMRebootDuration OID time, and then perform a delayedAllOnVM command.  Setting this OID to delayedAllRebootVM (8) will cause a delayedAllOffVM command to be performed. Each outlet will then wait its sPDUOutletConfigVMRebootDuration before returning power to the outlet.  Setting this OID to delayedSequenceAllRebootVM (9) will cause a delayedAllOffVM command to be performed. Once all outlets are off, the MasterSwitch VM will then delay the sPDUMasterStatusVMRebootDuration OID time, and then perform a delayedAllOnVM command.  Setting this OID to cancelAllPendingCommandsVM (10) will cause all pending commands on the MasterSwitch VM to be canceled.   Setting this OID to audioAlarmMute (11) will temporarily silence the audible alarm for the duration of the current overload condition. The audible alarm will be activated on subsequent overload alarms.  Getting this OID will return the noCommandAllVM (1) value.

Name: spdumaster config vm table size
Description: The number of MasterSwitch VMs configurable by this IP address.

Name: spdumaster config vm index
Description: The index to the MasterSwitch VM entry.

Name: spdumaster config vm name
Description: The name of the MasterSwitch VM. Maximum size is 23 characters.

Name: spdumaster config vm coldstart delay
Description: The amount of delay, in seconds, between when power is provided to the MasterSwitch VM and when the MasterSwitch VM provides basic master power to the outlets.  Allowed values are:  -1 never apply power automatically. 0 apply power immediately. 15 apply power in 15 seconds. 30 apply power in 30 seconds. 45 apply power in 45 seconds. 60 apply power in 60 seconds  (1 minute). 120 apply power in 120 seconds (2 minutes). 300 apply power in 300 seconds (5 minutes).  If a value other than a supported value is provided in a set request, the MasterSwitch VM interprets it as the next lower acceptable value.  If the provided value is lower than the lowest acceptable value, the lowest acceptable value is used.

Name: spdumaster config vm audio alarm activated
Description: Setting this OID to audioAlarmActiveNever (1) will disable the audio alarm on the MasterSwitch VM.  Setting this OID to audioAlarmActiveOnOverload (2) will activate the audio alarm on the MasterSwitch VM when an overload condition is present.  Setting this OID to audioAlarmActiveOnOverloadImminent (3) will activate the audio alarm on the MasterSwitch VM when the load on the MasterSwitch VM has surpassed the sPDUMasterConfigVMHighLoadWarningThreshold OID value.

Name: spdumaster configvmhigh load warning threshold
Description: A threshold that indicates the power consumption of the load is nearing an overload condition. It is represented as a percentage of full load.

Name: spdumaster configvmlow load warning threshold
Description: A threshold that indicates the power consumption of the load is nearing a low consumption condition. It is represented as a percentage of full load.

Name: spdumaster config vm overload restriction
Description: This OID controls the behavior of the MasterSwitch VM when an overload condition is possible and additional outlets are requested to be turned on.  Setting this OID to alwaysAllowTurnON (1) will always allow the outlets to turn on.  Setting this OID to restrictOnWarning (2) will not allow outlets to turn on if the sPDUMasterConfigVMHighLoadWarningThreshold OID is exceeded.  Setting this OID to restrictOnOverload (3) will not allow outlets to turn on if the MasterSwitch Vm is in an overload condition.

Name: spdumaster status vm command pending
Description: Getting this OID will return commandPendingMasterTrueVM (1) if the MasterSwitch VM has a pending command on any of its outlets.  commandPendingMasterFalseVM (2) will be returned if there are no pending commands.

Name: spdumaster statusvmoverload condition
Description: Getting this OID will return overloadConditionTrueVM (1) if the sPDUMasterConfigVMHighLoadWarningThreshold OID is violated.  overloadConditionFalseVM (2) will be returned if the sPDUMasterConfigVMHighLoadWarningThreshold OID is not violated.

Name: spdumaster statusvmlow load condition

Name: spduoutlet control vm outlet command: #[1.3.6.1.4.1.318.1.1.5.5.1.1.3]
Description: Getting this variable will return the outlet state. If the outlet is on, the immediateOnVM (1) value will be returned. If the outlet is off, the immediateOffVM (2) value will be returned.   Setting this variable to immediateOnVM (1) will immediately turn the outlet on.  Setting this variable to immediateOffVM (2) will immediately turn the outlet off.  Setting this variable to immediateRebootVM (3) will immediately reboot the outlet.  Setting this variable to delayedOnVM (4) will turn the outlet on after the sPDUOutletConfigVMPowerOnTime OID time has elapsed.  Setting this variable to delayedOffVM (5) will turn the outlet off after the sPDUOutletConfigVMPowerOffTime OID time has elapsed.  Setting this variable to delayedRebootVM  (6) will cause the MasterSwitch VM to perform a delayedOffVM command, wait the sPDUOutletConfigVMRebootDuration OID time, and then perform the immediateOnVM command.  Setting this variable to cancelPendingCommandVM (7) will cause any pending command to this outlet to be canceled.

Name: spduoutlet config vm power on time: #[1.3.6.1.4.1.318.1.1.5.6.1.1.3]
Description: The amount of time (in seconds) the outlet will delay powering on at coldstart or when a command that requires a turn-on delay is issued.  Allowed values are:  -1 never power on. 0  power on immediately. 15 power on 15 seconds after being commanded. 30 power on 30 seconds after being commanded. 45 power on 45 seconds after being commanded. 60 power on 60 seconds (1 minute) after being commanded. 120 power on 120 seconds (2 minutes) after being commanded. 300 power on 300 seconds (5 minutes) after being commanded.  If a value other than a supported value is provided in a set request, the MasterSwitch VM interprets it as the next lower acceptable value.  If the provided value is lower than the lowest acceptable value, the lowest acceptable value is used.

Name: spduoutlet config vm power off time: #[1.3.6.1.4.1.318.1.1.5.6.1.1.3]
Description: The amount of time (in seconds) the outlet will delay powering off when a command that requires a turn-off delay is issued.   Allowed values are:  -1 never power off automatically. 0  power off immediately. 15 power off 15 seconds after being commanded. 30 power off 30 seconds after being commanded. 45 power off 45 seconds after being commanded. 60 power off 60 seconds (1 minute) after being commanded. 120 power off 120 seconds (2 minutes) after being commanded. 300 power off 300 seconds (5 minutes) after being commanded.  If a value other than a supported value is provided in a set request, the MasterSwitch VM interprets it as the next lower acceptable value.  If the provided value is lower than the lowest acceptable value, the lowest acceptable value is used.

Name: spduoutlet config vm reboot duration: #[1.3.6.1.4.1.318.1.1.5.6.1.1.3]
Description: During a reboot sequence, power is turned off and then back on. This OID defines the amount of time to wait, in seconds, after turning the power off, at the start of the sequence, before turning power back on, at the end of the reboot sequence.  Allowed values are:  5 wait 5 seconds between off/on. 10 wait 10 seconds between off/on. 15 wait 15 seconds between off/on. 20 wait 20 seconds between off/on. 30 wait 30 seconds between off/on. 45 wait 45 seconds between off/on. 60 wait 60 seconds (1 minute) between off/on.  If a value other than a supported value is provided in a set request, the MasterSwitch VM interprets it as the next lower acceptable value.  If the provided value is lower than the lowest acceptable value, the lowest acceptable value is used.

Name: spdumaster controlmspcommand
Description: Setting this OID to immediateAllOnMSP (2) will turn all outlets on immediately.  Setting this OID to sequencedAllOnMSP (3) will turn all outlets on as defined by each outlet's sPDUOutletConfigMSPPowerOnDelay OID value.  Setting this OID to immediateAllOffMSP (4) will turn all outlets off immediately.  Setting this OID to gracefulAllRebootMSP (5) will reboot all outlets (after the device running PowerChute confirms shutdown) as defined by each outlet's sPDUOutletConfigMSPRebootDuration OID time value.  Setting this OID to immediateAllRebootMSP (6) will reboot all outlets immediately.  Setting this OID to gracefulAllShutdownMSP (7) will shutdown all outlets (after the device running PowerChute confirms shutdown) as defined by each outlet's sPDUOutletConfigMSPPowerOffDelay OID time value.  Each outlet will then turn on after the sum of its sPDUOutletConfigMSPRestartDelay and sPDUOutletConfigMSPPowerOnDelay OID values.  Setting this OID to overrideAllBatCapThreshMSP (8) will cause the outlet to ignore the Battery Capacity Threshold and proceed turning on the outlets as defined by each outlet's sPDUOutletConfigMSPPowerOnDelay OID value.  Setting this OID to cancelAllPendingCommandsMSP (9) will cause all pending commands on the MasterSwitch plus to be canceled.  Setting this OID to restoreFactoryDefaultsMSP (10) will cause the settings of the MasterSwitch plus to be restored to the factory defaults.  Getting this OID will return the noCommandAllMSP (1) value.

Name: spduoutlet controlmspoutlet command: #[1.3.6.1.4.1.318.1.1.6.5.1.1.3]
Description: Getting this variable will return the outlet state. If the outlet is on, the immediateOnMSP (1) value will be returned. If the outlet is off, the immediateOffMSP (3) value will be returned.  Setting this variable to immediateOnMSP (1) will immediately turn the outlet on.  Setting this variable to delayedOnMSP (2) will turn the outlet on after the sPDUOutletConfigMSPPowerOnDelay OID time has elapsed.  Setting this variable to immediateOffMSP (3) will immediately turn the outlet off.  Setting this variable to gracefulRebootMSP (4) will cause the outlet to wait for device confirmation (if applicable) and then turn the outlet off after the sPDUOutletConfigMSPPowerOffDelay OID time has elapsed.  The outlet will then turn on after the sPDUOutletConfigMSPRebootDuration OID time has elapsed.  Setting this variable to immediateRebootMSP (5) will immediately reboot the outlet.  Setting this variable to gracefulshutdownMSP (6) will cause the outlet to wait for device confirmation (if applicable) and then turn the outlet off after the sPDUOutletConfigMSPPowerOffDelay OID time has elapsed.  The outlet will then turn on after the sum of the sPDUOutletConfigMSPRestartTime OID time and the sPDUOutletConfigMSPPowerOnDelay OID time has elapsed.  Setting this variable to overrideBatCapThreshMSP (7) will cause the outlet to ignore the Battery Capacity Threshold and proceed waiting on the sPDUOutletConfigMSPPowerOnDelay OID time before turning the outlet on.  Setting this variable to cancelPendingCommandMSP (8) will cause any pending command to this outlet to be canceled.

Name: dm3status sys remote access
Description: Remote Access indicator This setting indicates if configuration (write) access to the powerplant is enabled or disabled at the powerplant level. This value will be accessEnabled (1) if remote configuration is enabled, and accessDisabled (2) if remote configuration is disabled.

Description: This variable shows the current active security access level of controller.  This can only be changed directly from the front panel.

Name: dm3status sys temp sanity
Description: System temperature sanity indicator.  Indicates if the system temperature is reasonable.  Reasonable is defined based on powerplant type.  A value of saneYes (1) indicates temperature is reasonable, a value of saneNo (2) indicates it is not.

Name: dm3status sys alarm state
Description: System Alarm State.  Reflects the alarm status of the overall DC system. If a minor alarm is present, the value will be alarmMinor(1). If a major alarm is present, the value will be alarmMajor(2). If both minor and a major alarm is present, the value will be alarmBoth(3). If no alarm is present, the value will be alarmNone(4).

Name: dm3status sys temp units
Description: The temperature scale used to display the temperature in the DC system, Celsius(1) or Fahrenheit(2). This setting is based on the system preferences configuration in the agent.

Name: ats config bank low load threshold
Description: A threshold that indicates the current drawn is nearing a low consumption condition. It is represented in Amps. A warning will be issued when the load is less than the threshold value.  A threshold value of 0 Amps disables this warning.  Maximum value must be less than the value returned by the atsConfigBankNearOverLoadThreshold OID.

Name: ats config bank near over load threshold
Description: A threshold that indicates the current drawn is nearing an overload condition. It is represented in Amps. A warning will be issued when the load is greater than or equal to the threshold value.  Minimum value must be greater than the value returned by the atsConfigBankLowLoadThreshold OID.  Maximum value must be less than or equal to the value returned by the atsConfigBankOverLoadThreshold OID.

Name: ats config bank over load threshold
Description: A threshold that indicates the current drawn has entered an overload condition. It is represented in Amps. A warning will be issued when the load is greater than or equal to the threshold value.  Minimum value must be greater than or equal to the value returned by the atsConfigBankNearOverLoadThreshold OID.  Maximum value must be less than or equal to the value returned by atsIdentDeviceRating OID.

Description: A threshold that indicates the current drawn is nearing a low consumption condition. It is represented in Amps. A warning will be issued when the load is less than the threshold value.  A threshold value of 0 Amps disables this warning.  Maximum value must be less than the value returned by the atsConfigPhaseNearOverLoadThreshold OID.

Name: ats config phase near over load threshold
Description: A threshold that indicates the current drawn is nearing an overload condition. It is represented in Amps. A warning will be issued when the load is greater than or equal to the threshold value.  Minimum value must be greater than the value returned by the atsConfigPhaseLowLoadThreshold OID.  Maximum value must be less than or equal to the value returned by the atsConfigPhaseOverLoadThreshold OID.

Name: ats config phase over load threshold

Minimum value must be greater than or equal to the value returned by the atsConfigPhaseNearOverLoadThreshold OID.  Maximum value must be less than or equal to the value returned by atsIdentDeviceRating OID.
